race.comment: CHILLI REAPER (6) has changed stables since last being seen at Ararat in early March. She makes her local debut on what is now her home track, and even though 900m is a tad on the short side for her, she has not had any public trials, so she should be fresh enough to give this a big shake. Follow the market moves. MAGIC FIELD (2) has needed racing this prep to get fit, and he fought on gamely to finish fourth at Gawler a fortnight ago over 1100m. He has not missed a cheque in 6 starts around this circuit over 900m, and he is set to put his best hoof forward in this. Each way. GATSBY CROWN (1) sat off the pace after missing the kick fresh up at Geelong, and he will have winkers on for the first time to keep him sharp. His only win came over this trip, and was on this unique course, so stick with him. ALL PINK (5) slides down further in class third up from a spell and with the right run can take this out. GOPHER FRANK (9) is a local gelding resuming. Include in all top 4 combos.
